s: The first state in the Country to launch a diabetes registry is?
In terms of Human Development Index during 1991-2001, the rank of Andhra Pradesh State Changed from
As per National Human Development Report (of India) 2001, the value of Human Development Index of Andhra Pradesh is
o: greater than the value of India
less than the value of India
just 1/4th of the HDI of India
x: In NHDR 2001, Andhra Pradesh's HDI (about 0.416) was below India's (about 0.472).

s: Who prepared the Andhra Pradesh Human Development Report, 2007?
o: Centre for Economic and Social Studies, Hyderabad
x: The AP Human Development Report 2007 was prepared by the Centre for Economic and Social Studies in Hyderabad.

s: In the latest sub-national HDI comparison, what is the rank of Kerala (HDI above 0.86)?
x: Kerala and Goa both have HDI values above 0.86, and Kerala ranks second.

s: According to the National Human Development Report 2001 of the Planning Commission, how did the HDI of Andhra Pradesh compare with India's?
x: In NHDR 2001 AP's HDI (0.416) was below India's (0.472), and AP ranked 10th among major States. The first option reverses the two figures, the second wrongly makes them equal, and 0.385 is not the cited value.

s: Which of the following pairs about the present HDI method is correctly matched?
o: Education – adult literacy rate and gross enrolment
Combining the three indices – arithmetic mean
Income – GNI per capita (PPP), entered as a logarithm
x: Income is GNI per capita (PPP) in log form; since 2010 education uses mean and expected years of schooling and the indices are combined by a geometric mean.

s: Why are IHDI and district-level indices considered useful alongside the Human Development Index in assessing Andhra Pradesh?
o: Because HDI hides inequality within a State
Because district-level indices measure only population size
Because IHDI replaces all district-level data with national averages
Because HDI measures only infrastructure and excludes health
x: HDI can conceal inequalities within a State; therefore, the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index and district-level indices provide a more differentiated assessment.

s: Since 2010, which method is used to combine the three HDI dimension indices?
x: Since 2010 the health, education and income indices are combined by a geometric mean.

s: Who conceived the Human Development Index?
x: Mahbub ul Haq conceived the HDI with Amartya Sen; UNDP published the first Human Development Report in 1990.

s: In which year was the first Human Development Report published by the UNDP?
x: UNDP published the first Human Development Report in 1990, conceived by Mahbub ul Haq with Amartya Sen.

s: According to the National Human Development Report 2001, what was Andhra Pradesh's rank among the major States?
x: NHDR 2001 of the Planning Commission placed AP 10th among major States, with HDI 0.416 against India's 0.472.

s: What was India's HDI in the sub-national HDI comparison of 2023?
x: The sub-national HDI 2023 put India at 0.732, with Goa and Kerala above 0.86.

s: The first Andhra Pradesh Human Development Report (2007) was sponsored by which of the following?
o: NITI Aayog and the World Bank
RBI and the Asian Development Bank
x: Like other State HDRs, the AP HDR 2007 prepared by CESS was sponsored by the Planning Commission and UNDP; it was released in June 2008.

s: Which rank did Andhra Pradesh get in the Social Progress Index drawn up by Institute for Competitiveness and Social Progress Imperative in December 2022?
x: In the Social Progress Index (Dec 2022) Andhra Pradesh ranked 23rd among States/UTs, so option 4 is correct; 9th is the SDG India Index/MPI rank, not SPI.

s: As per Social Progress Index, released in December, 2022, which of the following are on top three positions in very high social progress in Tier-1?
x: Social Progress Index (SPI) for States and Districts made by the Institute for Competitiveness and Social Progress Imperative was submitted to the Economic Advisory Council- Prime Minister and released in December, 2022. Tier-I : Very High Social Progress State SPI Rank Puducherry 65.99 1 Lakshadweep 65.89 2 Goa 65.53 3 Sikkim 65.10 4 Mizoram 64.19 5

s: Mission Antyodaya, which ranks gram panchayats through an annual survey, is a convergence framework of which Ministry?
x: It is the Ministry of Rural Development's framework, not a healthcare mission; AP's state average score was 61.

s: According to the SDG India Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh had which of the following status?
o: Score 74, rank 9 and Front Runner State
Score 84, rank 5 and Front Runner State
x: Andhra Pradesh scored 74, ranked ninth, and was classified as a Front Runner in the SDG India Index 2023-24.

s: In the SDG India Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh ranked first on which goal?
x: AP was 1st on SDG 7, 2nd on SDG 14 and 3rd on SDG 1; Kerala and Uttarakhand topped the index at 79.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's National Multidimensional Poverty Index?
o: It is prepared by NITI Aayog with UNDP and OPHI
It uses four dimensions and sixteen indicators
Headcount fell from 29.17 per cent (2013-14) to 11.28 per cent (2022-23)
About 24.82 crore people escaped multidimensional poverty (NITI, January 2024)
x: The National MPI uses three dimensions and twelve indicators.

s: As per the APSES 2024-25, what was the position of Andhra Pradesh among the least-poor States of India?
x: Andhra Pradesh was ranked as the 9th least-poor State according to the stated assessment.

s: Which of the following correctly states Andhra Pradesh's MPI position in the NITI Aayog National MPI for 2019-21?
x: Andhra Pradesh's MPI was 0.025 and its multidimensional poverty headcount was 6.06%, compared with India's 14.96%.

s: Which district had the lowest multidimensional poverty percentage among the following districts of Andhra Pradesh?
x: West Godavari had the lowest listed multidimensional poverty percentage at 2.42%, followed by Guntur, Krishna and Chittoor.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's State average score under Mission Antyodaya?
x: AP's State average Mission Antyodaya score was 61; 74 is its SDG India Index 2023-24 score.

s: As per NFHS-5 (2019-21), what was the contraceptive prevalence rate of Andhra Pradesh?
x: NFHS-5 put AP's contraceptive prevalence at 71.1%, above India's 66.7%.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank in the Social Progress Index released in December 2022?
x: In the Social Progress Index of December 2022, Andhra Pradesh was ranked 23rd.

s: To which body was the Social Progress Index (December 2022) submitted?
o: Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister
x: The Institute for Competitiveness and Social Progress Imperative prepared the SPI and gave it to the EAC-PM.

s: Which of the following were the top three in Tier-I of the Social Progress Index 2022?
x: Puducherry, Lakshadweep and Goa topped Tier-I of the SPI 2022.

s: Which States topped the SDG India Index 2023-24 with a score of 79?
x: Kerala and Uttarakhand shared the top place with 79; Andhra Pradesh scored 74 and was 9th.

s: What Human Development Index target was set by the Sunrise AP Vision 2029?
x: Sunrise AP Vision 2029 aimed at an HDI of over 0.9 by 2029.

s:
Consider the following statements about Swarna Andhra @2047:
1. It targets a GSDP of USD 2.4 trillion.
2. It targets a per capita income of over USD 43,000.
3. It targets 100% literacy.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Swarna Andhra @2047 aims at a GSDP of USD 2.4 trillion, per capita income over USD 43,000 and 100% literacy.

s: As per the AP Socio-Economic Survey 2024-25, what are the shares of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in Andhra Pradesh's population, respectively?
x: Scheduled Castes account for 17.08% and Scheduled Tribes for 5.53% of Andhra Pradesh's population.

s: According to Census 2011, what was the Scheduled Caste population of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The SC population was 84.69 lakh, about 4.21% of India's Scheduled Caste population.

s: As per Census 2011, which district of Andhra Pradesh had the highest share of Scheduled Castes?
x: Prakasam had the highest SC share (23.19%) and also the largest SC number.

s: As per Census 2011, Andhra Pradesh's SC population formed what share of India's SCs?
x: AP's 84.69 lakh SCs were 4.21% of India's SCs; 17.08% is the SC share of AP's own population.

s: In which district of Andhra Pradesh, is the proposed port at Dugarajapatnam located?
Among Andhra Pradesh's 28 districts (Census 2011 recast), which has the highest urbanisation?
x: Visakhapatnam is most urbanised (89.69 per cent) and Polavaram least (2.84 per cent); SPSR Nellore is most populous.

s: Among AP's 28 districts, which recorded the highest and the lowest literacy, respectively?
x: Visakhapatnam recorded the highest literacy (79.05%) and Alluri Sitarama Raju the lowest (44.67%).

s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh has the highest per capita income (GDDP)?
x: Visakhapatnam has the highest per capita GDDP among AP's districts.

s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh has the lowest per capita income (GDDP)?
x: Srikakulam has the lowest per capita GDDP; Visakhapatnam has the highest.

s: Among AP's 28 districts, which has the smallest population?
x: Polavaram has the smallest population (3.49 lakh) and SPSR Nellore the largest (24.17 lakh).

s: Among Andhra Pradesh's 28 districts, which has the lowest population density?
x: Polavaram has the lowest density (54 per sq km); Visakhapatnam has the highest.

s: Among Andhra Pradesh's 28 districts, which has the largest population?
x: SPSR Nellore has the largest population (24.17 lakh); Polavaram the smallest.

s: What is Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (formerly Aarogyasri)?
o: school assistance scheme of ₹15,000 per child
cashless healthcare scheme for 1.43 crore families
x: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva provides cashless care to 1.43 crore families and covers 3,257 procedures.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Talliki Vandanam?
o: It is calculated per child, not per mother
It is the successor to Amma Vodi
It gives Rs 15,000 per child per year to the mother
x: Talliki Vandanam covers both government and private schools.

s: Which pair correctly gives Andhra Pradesh's MMR and IMR?
x: AP's MMR is 30 and IMR 19, so AP fares better on health than on literacy.

s: As per SRS 2016-20, what was the life expectancy of Andhra Pradesh?
x: AP's life expectancy was 70.6 years against India's 70.0 years.

s: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva provides cashless care to about how many families?
x: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva covers 1.43 crore families for 3,257 procedures.

s: Which of the following is NOT an Aspirational District of Andhra Pradesh?
x: AP's three Aspirational Districts are Alluri Sitharama Raju, Parvathipuram Manyam and YSR Kadapa; Srikakulam is not one.

s: Which Aspirational District represents the lagging Rayalaseema belt of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Rayalaseema's lagging belt is represented by YSR Kadapa; tribal North Andhra by ASR.
